name: winbox
description: Modern HTML5 window manager for the web.
author: Thomas Wilkerling

scripts.build:css:bundle: node task/bundle --image && lessc tmp/bundle.less dist/css/winbox.min.css && csso dist/css/winbox.min.css --output dist/css/winbox.min.css
scripts.build:css:theme-modern: lessc src/css/themes/modern.less dist/css/themes/modern.min.css && csso dist/css/themes/modern.min.css --output dist/css/themes/modern.min.css
scripts.build:css:theme-white: lessc src/css/themes/white.less dist/css/themes/white.min.css && csso dist/css/themes/white.min.css --output dist/css/themes/white.min.css
scripts.build:css:theme-fluent: lessc src/css/themes/fluent.less dist/css/themes/fluent.min.css && csso dist/css/themes/fluent.min.css --output dist/css/themes/fluent.min.css
scripts.build:css:theme-material: lessc src/css/themes/material.less dist/css/themes/material.min.css && csso dist/css/themes/material.min.css --output dist/css/themes/material.min.css
scripts.build:css:theme-dark: lessc src/css/themes/dark.less dist/css/themes/dark.min.css && csso dist/css/themes/dark.min.css --output dist/css/themes/dark.min.css
scripts.build:css:theme-default: lessc src/css/themes/default.less dist/css/themes/default.min.css && csso dist/css/themes/default.min.css --output dist/css/themes/default.min.css
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy && npm run build:svg && npm run build:css && npm run build:css:bundle && npm run build:css:theme-modern && npm run build:css:theme-white && npm run build:css:theme-fluent && npm run build:css:theme-material && npm run build:css:theme-dark && npm run build:css:theme-default && node task/bundle --style && npm run build:js && npm run build:bundle && echo Build Complete. && exit 0
